content: LLM structured-output guardrail pattern: emit an enum-constrained label, bounded confidence float, reasons list, and a requires_human_review boolean. Pipeline is LLM generates -> deterministic rules engine validates against controlled vocabulary -> rules engine has veto power -> on failure route to human review, never silently auto-correct or auto-pass. The requires_human_review field is the one teams most often skip, and it's the one that pays for itself.
